prompts.name: wagon
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent PNG sprite for BitDog, a polished painterly 2D side-scrolling golden retriever game. Reference image is STYLE ONLY: warm hand-painted wood textures, soft golden sunlight, clear dark silhouette and creamy lit edges. Generate ONE isolated complete object, generous transparent margin, genuinely transparent background with alpha, no scenery, no text, no dog, no people. Mostly side elevation with a small amount of visible top depth, camera almost level so walkable surfaces run horizontally. Physically credible construction and proportions, no fantasy floating pieces. A sturdy apple orchard picking wagon: long low honey-brown wooden flatbed, faded sage-green steel undercarriage, two large clearly visible dark rubber wheels with hubs and axles, a small folded tow handle at the left kept below deck. Empty broad deck for walking, NO side rails above deck. A few red apples in a small basket mounted BELOW the deck between wheels. Walkable wooden deck straight and horizontal from left to right, wheels touch the same ground line. Overall width about 3.5 times total height. Entire wagon visible including wheels. Landscape canvas.
